steps.name: Shipping Address (Xsolla Pay Station, step 1 — observed; empty-form validation observed 2026-09-30)
options: Country is pre-filled 'USA' (grey selector row; not flagged on validation).
Phone has a US-flag + '+' country-code prefix and IS required for guest checkout.
Apartment is the only optional field (shows a green check mark when the empty form is validated).
steps.notes: Page heading 'Shipping Address'; blue info banner reads 'You cannot change your shipping address once you submit your pre-order.' for the GTA VI code-in-box (the merchandise flow's banner says '…submit your order.'). Field order: Country · First Name · Last Name · City · Region/State · Postal Code · Street Address · Apartment · Phone · Email, then the gold CONTINUE button (bottom right). Validation, observed by pressing CONTINUE on the empty form: no page-level error; every required input gets a red 4px bar on its left edge; the first invalid field (First Name) is focused with a gold border and a small red tooltip 'Required' appears under it; clicking into another empty required field (e.g. Phone) moves the 'Required' tooltip to that field; Apartment shows a green check. 'Required' is the only message text seen — format errors (bad email/phone/ZIP) were not observed because no data was typed. Xsolla's consent bar ('I give my consent for Xsolla to use my personal data to offer and/or market customized services to me.' / 'I consent to enable all cookies listed within the Cookie Policy.' / 'Agree to all' / X) overlays the CONTINUE button until dismissed with its X. Footer: 'Xsolla is an authorized video game software distributor…', '© 2006-2026 Xsolla', 'Secure Connection', Privacy Policy | EULA | Refund Policy | Legal Agreements. No order summary, price, shipping or charge-timing text on this step. The iframe is cross-origin (the parent page's accessibility tree only exposes an 'Entering checkout window' placeholder), so it was read from screenshots. Lightbox 680×650, theme 'rockstar-dark', currency USD, language en.

quirks: The Rockstar Store only sells the Standard Edition code-in-box ($79.99) directly. The digital Standard and Ultimate editions are 'First Party Link Out SKUs' — their Pre-Order Now buttons window.open() the PlayStation Store or Microsoft Store in a new tab. Ultimate Edition is not sold as code-in-box here.

A platform (PS5 / Xbox Series X|S) must be picked on the product page; the picker is unselected on load and drives which store the digital buttons open and which code-in-box SKU (357725-US vs 357733-US) is added.

The hero 'Pre-Order Now' and sub-nav 'Pre-Order Now' buttons only scroll to Compare Editions; the real add-to-cart is the 'Pre-Order Now $79.99' button in the 'Physical (Code-in-Box) Version Available' section.

Age gate on the code-in-box button: 'Verify your age' modal with Month/Day/Year dropdowns and a disabled 'OK' until filled (JSON-LD declares requiredMinAge 18). Passing it does NOT add to the cart — it goes straight to the 'Sign In or Continue as Guest' modal and then the Xsolla lightbox on the product page; the Rockstar cart stays empty and there is no 'Added to Cart' popover for the game.
No disc: physical box contains only a download code; PlayStation codes are region-locked; shipping starts November 12, 2026 (pre-load date), one week before the November 19 release.

Checkout is handled by Xsolla (merchant of record for physical items) inside a 680×650 lightbox iframe — over /cart for merchandise, but directly over the product page for the GTA VI code-in-box; the URL is store.xsolla.com/pages/cart → purchase.xsolla.com with a guest auth token and a base64 access_data blob (project_id 100851, theme 'rockstar-dark').
Guest checkout is offered via a 'Sign In or Continue as Guest' modal; signing in uses a Rockstar Games Account OAuth popup at signin.rockstargames.com. No account is required.

Shipping address is entered first; the GTA VI banner says 'You cannot change your shipping address once you submit your pre-order.' Every address field except Apartment is required (Phone included); empty required fields get a red left bar and a 'Required' tooltip on the focused field.
Max quantity 4 per SKU; cart quantity is a 'Qty: 1' dropdown menu button.
Free standard shipping over $74.99 (the $79.99 game qualifies); cart shows a dollar-amount-to-free-shipping progress message.
No promo-code field, no express pay buttons, no store pickup, no protection plan or membership upsell in cart.
Two separate cookie consents: OneTrust banner on store.rockstargames.com (ACCEPT ALL COOKIES / REJECT ALL / COOKIE SETTINGS) and Xsolla's own consent checkboxes inside the checkout iframe.
Cancelling a pre-order is not possible in the store UI — shoppers must use Xsolla's cancel-pre-order form with order number + email.

Page titles are 'My Cart' and 'My Search'; the site is a Next.js app (product/SKU data is embedded in __NEXT_DATA__ and schema.org JSON-LD with availability 'PreOrder' and availabilityStarts 2026-11-19).

gaps: Xsolla checkout was observed through step 1 (Shipping Address) including its empty-form validation; shipping-method options/prices/ETAs, the payment-method list for project 100851, card field labels, the pay-button label, the confirmation headline and the exact order-number length are still not observed (submitting the address form requires typing personal data). They are filled from Xsolla help/developer pages and best knowledge — marked low/medium confidence.

Format-level validation messages on the Xsolla address form (invalid email/phone/ZIP) were not observed because no data was typed; only the empty-field 'Required' state was seen. The age gate has no messages (OK stays disabled) and the guest modal has no inputs.

Charge timing ('charged when ready to ship') is confirmed absent from the store UI through the Shipping Address step, but the payment step was not reached, so whether Pay Station shows a pre-order/charge notice there is unverified. Xsolla's general refund policy ('payment is taken at the time of purchase' for pre-orders) conflicts with its physical-pre-order help page.
